title: The reader as a defence, and what rides in anyway

hypotheses.H10.1: On empty grooming, the intent-gate absorbs less than the surface filter at equal or better retention of genuine work.
hypotheses.H10.2: On mimicry, the intent-gate does NO BETTER and may do WORSE than the surface filter. Predicted against interest.
hypotheses.H10.3: The learned-values reader shows monotone value drift and its gate widens as it drifts -- the doom loop.
hypotheses.H10.4: The rider drifts comparably to the ungated reader despite a shut value gate. Values ride in on process.
hypotheses.H10.5: Adversarial engagement suppresses goal and value uptake substantially more than process uptake.
hypotheses.H10.6: Process uptake predicts value uptake at fixed goal uptake. Bar: partial correlation above 0.2.
hypotheses.H10.7: With evasion tracking detection, the false-alarm rate is NON-MONOTONE in detector training.
hypotheses.H10.8: A stale detector fails ASYMMETRICALLY rather than simply becoming noisy.

nulls.N45: on a clean corpus the intent-gate costs nothing
nulls.N46: the surface filter works on something
nulls.N47: the intent-gate never reads the provenance signal
nulls.N48: the E56 design varies process uptake while holding goal readability fixed
nulls.N49: with evasion off, E57 reproduces E53's monotone decline
nulls.N50: value drift is zero on a clean corpus, for every reader
nulls.N51: reader 7's value gate is verifiably shut

authors_recorded_priors.H10.6: the author predicts values ride in on process, citing mere exposure, and stated before the run that a null would be read as evidence the MODEL is wrong rather than as an uninteresting negative
authors_recorded_priors.N45: the author flagged this as the null he most expected to fail, named E8 as the reason, and directed the run to proceed on the stated grounds that the project's present position is one of overconfidence and the correct response to overconfidence is more validation rather than less

may_not_claim: the contamination motivating E55 is documented; no causal attribution of real-world model value-drift to any real-world actor is made or supported
severity_rule: every V10 headline gets a severity draw and an ablation row before it gets a sentence in any document, because V9 established that every finding in this project rests on one commitment -- the reader modelling a maker -- so any new finding generated by looking at this model will also reproduce
not_built: the human acquisition test -- top external priority on the human side
the terminal AI-side step: an intent-gate in a real training pipeline on real corpora
